# MC-17: A friendly local web app in Vietnamese that walks a non-technical operator through one pilot video, with in-browser recording

- Source: the CEO's request in chat, 2026-10-27; local://research/ceo-decision-record.md#ceo-d-1300 to #ceo-d-1309
- Issue type: Feature   Priority: Highest
- Labels: affiliate, shopee-video, pilot, operator-ux, web-app, recording, vietnamese
- Routed as: /implement (implement-feature)
- Builds on: MC-16 (`src/MediaCompany.Pilot`, branch `claude/mc-16-pilot-pipeline-a4df61`, run `run-535f3f938f32`), not yet merged to `main`

## Description

### WHY

The CEO's request, verbatim: "người dùng là non tech user human vì vậy những việc như trong hướng dẫn vận hành công cụ
gây khó khăn. hãy viết một tool web app có UI,UX frendly cho user nhập dữ liệu từng step bao gồm cả việc support ghi âm
trực tiếp thay vì bắt user tải file."

(The user is a non-technical human, so the tasks in the operator guide are hard. Write a web app tool with a friendly
UI/UX where the user enters data step by step, including direct recording support instead of making the user upload a
file.)

MC-16 delivered `src/MediaCompany.Pilot`, an offline .NET 10 console tool with five verbs (check, script, produce,
approve, verify). Its operator guide `pilot-affiliate-vn/mc-16/03-huong-dan-van-hanh.md` asks the operator to hand-edit
a JSON fact sheet, lay out an input folder, type command lines with paths and copy a 64-character hash. The operator is
the CEO now and a human employee later (`CEO-D-1306` item 1, `CEO-D-1307` item 2). MC-17 puts a friendly local web
front end on top of the MC-16 tool so the operator never edits JSON or types a command line.

### THE STEPS THE OPERATOR WALKS THROUGH, ONE VIDEO AT A TIME

1. **Fact sheet in a form.** Every field of the MC-16 fact sheet, each fact row with its source section and its
   screenshot. Banned terms are checked live as the operator types, naming the term and why it is banned (its class).
2. **Product images.** Upload or pick the three images.
3. **Script.** See the generated script and tick each sentence's Part E source line.
4. **Record the narration in the browser.** No file upload is required, though upload stays an option. A timer with a
   hard stop at 60 s, playback, re-record. The recording is converted with the installed ffmpeg. Never text-to-speech,
   never voice cloning, and a reused recording is refused.
5. **Presenter clip.** Upload the AI-presenter clip the operator made in HeyGen or D-ID; the app checks it is portrait
   and that its length matches the recording within 0.5 s (`CEO-D-1308` item 3).
6. **Produce the package.** Show progress and every refusal in plain Vietnamese with what to do next; offer a manual
   timing editor when pause detection does not match the sentence count.
7. **Preview and approve.** Preview the video and the kit 04 checklist; the CEO ticks B3, B5 and the other items and
   approves the video by its hash (`D-002`, `CEO-D-1309` item 2).

### WHAT THE COMPANY ALREADY HOLDS — REUSE IT

- `src/MediaCompany.Pilot` and its 251 tests in `tests/MediaCompany.Pilot.Tests`: the fact sheet check, the banned-term
  check, the script generator, admission of recording and clip, pause timing and `timing.txt`, ffmpeg 9:16 composition,
  the package, the hash-chained ledger, approval by hash and verify.
- The MC-16 run evidence `.claude/runs/run-535f3f938f32/` (technical design, ADRs D-001 to D-005, release note with
  known issues K-001 to K-016).
- Installed on this machine: the .NET 10 SDK with the ASP.NET Core 10 shared framework, ffmpeg and ffprobe through
  WinGet (`C:/Users/vuhoangcao/AppData/Local/Microsoft/WinGet/Links/`), a Chromium-based browser with MediaRecorder.

### HARD CONSTRAINTS

1. Download nothing (no npm, NuGet or pip package, no CDN script, no font) unless the CEO approves it by name.
2. The app calls no generative model, no speech recognition and no metered service. No text-to-speech, no voice
   cloning (`CEO-D-1304`, `CEO-D-1305`, `CEO-D-1307`).
3. **Socket conflict, for the Scope Gate.** `CEO-D-1308` keeps the MC-16 toolchain at zero sockets. A web app must
   listen on a socket, and microphone access needs a secure context, which `localhost` provides. The proposal for the
   CEO: the web app binds 127.0.0.1 only, opens no outbound connection, and the MC-16 tool itself stays at zero sockets.
   The CEO decides this explicitly before design.
4. The web app is a front end only. It weakens no MC-16 check: the hash approval, the 60 s limit, refusal of a reused
   recording, the safe area, the banned-term checks, the 0.5 s clip tolerance and the 1.2 s caption page all stay in the
   tool, which keeps deciding.
5. Agents never sign in anywhere, create accounts, contact sellers, buy anything or publish anything. Nothing publishes.
6. Frozen Wave 12 (MC-13) and Wave 13 (MC-14) are not touched. The `mediacompany` database is not touched; Docker is down.
7. Tests run offline with fixtures generated by code. No media file is added to the repository. The recording flow is
   covered by a test that needs no real microphone.
8. Every publication is approved by the CEO individually (`D-002`); the CEO carries the legal position (`D-018`).

### DONE MEANS

- MC-17 runs through every phase and gate of `implement-feature`; the CEO decides at the Scope and Design gates.
- The app has been run and shown working in the Browser pane on a code-generated sample, including the record step.
- Committed and pushed on the session branch; the CEO gets the compare link against `main`, noting that the branch is
  cut from the unmerged MC-16 branch.

### FRAMEWORK DEFECTS TO BRIEF EVERY SUBAGENT ON

All in `research/framework-defects.md`. Every agent gets its own staging folder; a non-implementing role writes no
repository file; an agent claiming a finding covers "every" case lists the cases; a `failure-envelope.json` of class
`gate-approval-required` in a phase folder is stale once that phase's dispatch prompt exists (Finding 11).

## Acceptance criteria

_To be defined by the scope phase and approved at the Scope Gate._

# Business intent for MC-17 (the owner's request and decisions, verbatim)

## The CEO's request, 2026-10-27, in chat

"người dùng là non tech user human vì vậy những việc như trong hướng dẫn vận hành công cụ gây khó khăn. hãy viết một tool web app có UI,UX frendly cho user nhập dữ liệu từng step bao gồm cả việc support ghi âm trực tiếp thay vì bắt user tải file."

---

## CEO-D-1304 — The AI presenter lip-syncs to the CEO's own recorded voice

**The CEO's own decision, 2026-10-26**, given in the chat with the orchestrator session, on the presenter form of
`CEO-D-1301` item 4 and the tool choice `OD12` of `CEO-D-1302`.

The CEO's words: "anh mở tài khoản shopee rồi . về tiếng việt là tiếng mẹ đẻ có thể dùng bản ghi âm của anh được" (I
have opened the Shopee account. As for Vietnamese, it is my native language, so my own recordings can be used). Asked
whether an AI face is still needed with a real voice, the CEO chose "Mặt AI + giọng anh" (AI face plus my voice) over
dropping the avatar.

1. **Voice.** The narration of every video is the CEO's own recorded voice, in Vietnamese. The AI face lip-syncs to
   that recording. No text-to-speech is used in the pilot, and Vbee is dropped.
2. **Proposed default, not the CEO's words: no voice cloning.** Each video uses a fresh real recording of its own
   approved script; no tool is given the CEO's voice to clone. This is the orchestrator's proposed default and stands
   only when the CEO confirms it.
3. **Tool (`OD12` revised, a proposal for the CEO).** Whichever of HeyGen and D-ID passes the lip-sync test (file
   `pilot-affiliate-vn/pilot-kit/07-kich-ban-thu-va-mo-ta-nguoi-dan.md`) driven by the CEO's own uploaded recording is
   bought, billed monthly at USD 29 (HeyGen Creator or D-ID Pro), from the USD 42.99 fixed line of `OD13`. The D-ID
   Pro plus Vbee path (about USD 35.43, ESTIMATE) falls away. What the evidence says
   (`pilot-affiliate-vn/evidence/ai-presenter-pricing-2026-10-26.md`):
   - D-ID Studio accepts uploaded audio, MP3 or WAV up to 5 minutes. The quote ("upload an audio file for your avatar to
     speak") comes from a D-ID help search result, not a fetched page. D-ID Pro keeps a visible generic "AI" mark in
     the bottom left corner (D3).
   - HeyGen's acceptance of uploaded audio is not quoted anywhere in the evidence: **UNVERIFIED**, settled by the test.
   - Whether either free tier or trial accepts uploaded audio is **UNVERIFIED**, settled by the test.
4. **Everything else stands.** The "Video tạo bởi AI" label is still turned on for every video, because the face is AI.
   Scripts use only sourced facts and never claim use of the product. The disclosure is spoken at the start and the
   end. The Article 15a(3) stop rule (`OD14`), `D-002`, and one presenter on one account (`OD18`) are unchanged.
5. **Fact reported, not verified:** the CEO reports opening "the Shopee account" on 2026-10-26. No agent has seen it;
   agents never sign in. Whether it is the Shopee Affiliate registration as an individual KOC, and so whether day 1 of
   the plan is 2026-10-26, is for the CEO to state in the measurement sheet. If it is, the "before day 1" steps
   (counsel pack sent, eligibility checked) are already due.
6. **Effect on the open questions, an inference for counsel and not a finding:** the presenter now speaks in the
   CEO's real voice, which may bear on whether the CEO is presenting the product personally under Article 15a(3)
   (`Q-002`, `Q-016`). The counsel pack asks this.

**Unchanged:** `D-002` (the CEO approves every publication), `D-018`; agents create no account, sign in nowhere,
contact no seller, buy nothing, download no asset and publish nothing.

---

## CEO-D-1305 — No voice cloning: every video uses a fresh real recording

**The CEO's own decision, 2026-10-26**, given in the chat with the MC-16 session, on the proposed default of
`CEO-D-1304` item 2.

Asked "Không nhân bản giọng: mỗi video dùng một bản ghi âm thật, ghi mới. CEO xác nhận hay bác bỏ?", the CEO chose
"Xác nhận".

1. **Confirmed.** No tool is given the CEO's voice to clone, and no voice-generation or "voice clone" feature is turned
   on in the presenter tool. Each video uses a fresh real recording of its own approved script, made after that script
   is approved; sentences are never spliced from another video's recording. `CEO-D-1304` item 2 stands as a decision,
   no longer as a proposal.
2. **Effect on the kit and on MC-16.** Part F of `pilot-affiliate-vn/pilot-kit/03-mau-kich-ban-nguoi-dan-ai.md` drops
   its "awaiting confirmation" note. The MC-16 toolchain refuses to package a video whose recording is not new for that
   video: a recording whose digest was already used by another video is rejected.

**Unchanged:** `D-002`, `D-018`, `CEO-D-1304` item 1 (no text-to-speech); agents create no account, sign in nowhere,
contact no seller, buy nothing, download no asset and publish nothing.

---

## CEO-D-1306 — MC-16 scope answers: the tool writes the script, a call to action without price, pause-detected captions, 60 seconds is a hard limit

**The CEO's own decision, 2026-10-26**, given in the chat with the MC-16 session on the four blocking questions of the
MC-16 scope phase (run `run-535f3f938f32`).

1. **The tool writes the script for the CEO to record.** Asked how each fact row becomes a spoken sentence when the
   toolchain may use no language model, the CEO's words: "viết kịch bản cho CEO thu âm. sau này sẽ handover lại cho
   nhân viên là human." (write the script for the CEO to record; later this will be handed over to a human employee).
   The orchestrator reads this as: the script generator produces every spoken sentence itself, deterministically, from
   the fact sheet; the CEO does not write sentences. The person who runs the tool and records is the operator (the CEO
   now, a human employee later); the per-publication approval stays the CEO's under `D-002`. Whether the employee may
   also record the voice is not decided here: `CEO-D-1304` names the CEO's voice, and a change needs a CEO decision.
2. **The call to action carries no price.** Asked about the template's guidance sentence, which says "giá", the CEO's
   words: "hãy dùng câu dễ dẫn dắt khách hàng bằng cách bấm vào giỏ hàng, bấm link để xem chi tiết...." (use a sentence
   that leads the customer to tap the cart or the link to see details). Part B row 6 of the script template is
   replaced by a call to tap the cart or the product link for details, with no price, discount or urgency wording.
   The bare word "giá" is not a banned term (it would refuse products such as "giá đỡ điện thoại"); money amounts,
   discounts, promotions, sold counts and ratings stay banned.
3. **Caption timing by pause detection.** The CEO chose the proposed default: the tool finds the pauses between
   sentences in the recording by signal processing (no speech recognition); the operator reads with a clear pause
   between sentences; when the pauses found do not match the sentence count, the tool stops and the operator writes the
   timings by hand.
4. **Sixty seconds is a hard limit.** The CEO chose "Chặn trên 60 giây": a recording longer than 60 seconds is refused;
   the operator drops the optional third fact and records again. The 5-minute upload ceiling is moot below it.

**Unchanged:** `D-002`, `D-018`, `CEO-D-1304`, `CEO-D-1305`; agents create no account, sign in nowhere, contact no
seller, buy nothing, download no asset and publish nothing.

---

## CEO-D-1307 — MC-16 Scope Gate approved; an employee operator may record in their own real voice

**The CEO's own decision, 2026-10-26**, at the Scope Gate of run `run-535f3f938f32` (MC-16).

1. **Scope approved** as the scope phase's third attempt states it, with the defaults it carries: captions in white on
   a dark band in the lower third, one per sentence; a presenter clip that is not portrait is refused; product images
   move by a slow pan or zoom; recording reuse is detected by the file's digest only; banned class (f) is "so với",
   "hơn hẳn" and naming another shop or brand as better, not the bare word "hơn".
2. **Employee voice.** Asked whether a human employee who later operates the tool may record the narration, the CEO
   chose "Được, giọng thật" (yes, in their real voice). This amends `CEO-D-1304` item 1: the narration is the real
   recorded voice of the CEO or of the employee operating the tool. Still no text-to-speech, no voice cloning, and a
   fresh recording for every video (`CEO-D-1305`). The presenter stays one presenter on one account (`OD18`). Whether
   a different human voice behind the same AI face bears on counsel questions Q-002 and Q-016 is an inference for
   counsel, not a finding.

**Unchanged:** `D-002` (the CEO approves every publication), `D-018`; agents create no account, sign in nowhere,
contact no seller, buy nothing, download no asset and publish nothing.

---

## CEO-D-1308 — MC-16 Design Gate approved, with phone-screen safe areas

**The CEO's own decision, 2026-10-26**, at the Design Gate of run `run-535f3f938f32` (MC-16).

1. **Design approved with safe areas.** The design composes the 1080x1920 (9:16) video with the installed ffmpeg only,
   with no browser and no socket, in a separate .NET tool that never touches the company store; the pilot ledger is a
   hash-chained file outside the repository. Asked first, the CEO answered "khung hinh dien thoai di dong vi da so
   nguoi dung xem reels hoac youtube short" (a mobile phone frame, because most people watch Reels or YouTube Shorts).
   Asked again with the design restated as that frame plus safe areas, the CEO chose "Duyệt kèm vùng an toàn".
   - Captions and the overlay "Video tạo bởi AI · Có liên kết tiếp thị" sit inside a safe area, clear of the
     right-hand action buttons (like, comment, cart) and the caption and description text at the bottom of the Shopee
     Video, Reels and Shorts players.
   - The text is large enough to read on a small screen.
   The tool still publishes nowhere.
2. **Fallback for Vietnamese marks.** If the proof frame shows ffmpeg drawing a Vietnamese mark wrongly, the CEO allows
   ahead of time ("Cho phép nội bộ") the fallback: the installed browser renderer draws only the caption plates as
   transparent images. It may open loopback sockets on 127.0.0.1 only, never a connection off the machine, and the
   package states it.
3. **Clip and recording tolerance.** The presenter clip and the recording start together, and their lengths may differ
   by at most 0.5 s ("0,5 giây"). Beyond that, the tool refuses and names the difference in seconds.

**Unchanged:** `D-002`, `D-018`, `CEO-D-1304` to `CEO-D-1307`; agents create no account, sign in nowhere, contact no
seller, buy nothing, download no asset and publish nothing.

---

## CEO-D-1309 — MC-16 quality review: long captions page in two-line pages; B3 and B5 stay for the CEO to tick

**The CEO's own decision, 2026-10-27**, on the quality review of run `run-535f3f938f32` (MC-16).

1. **Caption paging.** At 56 px inside the safe area of `CEO-D-1308`, the fixed disclosure sentence needs four lines.
   The CEO chose "Chia trang 2 dòng": a sentence too long for two lines is shown as consecutive two-line pages
   within the time window in which it is spoken. Each page stays on screen for at least 1.2 s. Where the window is
   too short for that, the tool refuses and names the sentence. This amends the scope rule of one caption, of at most
   two lines, per sentence.
2. **B3 and B5 are not pre-ticked.** The price and claim-of-use checks are closed word lists. They are widened (for
   example "VNĐ", "nghìn", "triệu", and first-person wording in an operator's override), but cannot catch every
   phrasing. The CEO chose "CEO tự tích": the package states that the tool's check found nothing, and leaves B3 ("no
   claim of use") and B5 ("no price") unticked for the CEO, who reads the script. Only B8 (the "Video tạo bởi AI"
   overlay for the whole video) is pre-ticked. This amends the scope rule that pre-ticked exactly B3, B5 and B8.

**Unchanged:** `D-002`, `D-018`, `CEO-D-1304` to `CEO-D-1308`; agents create no account, sign in nowhere, contact no
seller, buy nothing, download no asset and publish nothing.

  - Fact sheet form with every field and per-row screenshot; stored text is the typed text after NFC (S-003; C-001).

  - Images step accepting exactly the three named files (S-005; C-003); script step gated by one tick per sentence (S-006; C-004).
  - In-browser recording with a 60.0 s hard stop, playback and re-record; upload stays an option (S-007, S-008, S-030; C-005).
  - Upload passes unchanged; a browser take is converted once with the installed ffmpeg; reuse is refused by the toolchain (S-009, S-010, S-028; C-006).
  - Presenter clip checked for portrait and 0.5 s length difference (S-011, S-031; C-007).
  - Production with progress, the toolchain's line unchanged plus a Vietnamese reason and next step, and a timing editor (S-012, S-013, S-029; C-008).

### 5.3 Selected Approach

- Selected: O-003 (the process boundary, D-001), the structural choice the other five sub-decisions sit inside.
- Per-decision selections: D-002 O-005, D-003 O-009, D-004 O-012, D-005 O-015, D-006 O-018.
- Structural change: a new web project M-001 serving the page set M-002 on 127.0.0.1 only; it references the toolchain project for in-process pure checks, settings validation, probe and conversion, and starts the toolchain executable as a child for every decision (check, script, produce, approve, verify). A new zero-package test program M-003 and a solution entry M-011. Files only, in the pilot folder (M-008) and the app record (M-017). No existing module changes contract or dependencies.
- Rationale: O-003 is the only process boundary that answers the live check from the toolchain's own list (C-002) without running produce inside the listener's process (C-012, F-006), with one resident process to operate. O-005 gives a reproducible admitted file through the toolchain's own digest-checked ffmpeg runner (F-011, F-023). O-009 refuses the six SC-24 cases with no single header deciding. O-012 sources every CEO number from the repository's example file and lets the toolchain validate the result. O-015 is forced by C-021. O-018 tests recording with no microphone and no download.
- Highest-scoring rejected alternative and why it lost: O-004 ties O-003 on every criterion up to operability and loses there, because it adds a second resident process and a message form that must follow the library. It becomes the selection if the CEO reads CEO decision 1310 item 1 strictly (A-002, Q-001).
- Tradeoffs accepted:
  - Toolchain library code runs inside the process that owns the listener, for pure checks, probe and conversion only; produce, approve and verify never do (A-002).
  - The recording reuse refusal is shown at produce, because only the toolchain child opens the ledger (D-008).
  - The test program does not use the repository's test framework (A-008, Q-002).
  - Progress shows elapsed time and running state only, because the toolchain prints at the end (D-009).

- API changes: M-001 adds local routes reachable from 127.0.0.1 only, none used by another system:
  - Read routes (host allow-list only, no state change): pages and assets, progress, checklist, package video for preview, setup status.
  - State-changing routes (host allow-list, exact Origin and per-start token): setup save, shortcut creation, fact sheet save, live check, image upload, screenshot upload, script run, script tick save, take upload, take accept, recording upload, clip upload, produce start, timing save, checklist tick save, approval, verify.
- Contract compatibility notes:
  - M-004, M-005, M-009 and M-010 are consumed unchanged (C-015); no module has contract-change, so no transition strategy is required.
  - The approver text convention of D-005 lives inside the existing free-text field; a record written by the MC-16 command line stays valid and reads the same in verify.
  - M-001 parses two toolchain lines: the package folder from the produce success or held line, and the verify line; both forms are pinned by parity fixtures in P-015 (R-004).
- Schema or migration changes:
  - None in the company store (C-018); no data migration.
  - New files only, with no prior data: migration direction is not applicable, reversibility is total (removing M-001 leaves the toolchain's files readable), and every new file carries a form version so a later reader refuses a form it does not know.

  - App record: pilot folder, settings file path, toolchain executable path and SHA-256, port, CEO name, form version.

  - Takes folder: the raw browser take of the current video until replaced.
  - Web folder: per video, the ticked script lines, the ticked checklist items and the last package folder produced by the app; the log.

## Operational Considerations

- Logging and observability updates: D-014's local log in the web folder (M-008); the toolchain keeps its own run record and invoked-tool log inside each package (M-004); nothing reaches the company store (C-018).
- Error handling strategy (S12):
  - The toolchain's exit status decides the category: 0 done, 2 refused, 3 tool failure, 1 app fault (D-010).
  - A step pre-check failure in M-001 is shown in Vietnamese and stops before any toolchain call; the toolchain's own refusal remains authoritative (C-015).
  - A child that exceeds the app's bound is ended with its job, and the page shows a tool failure (D-009).
  - Setup refuses, in Vietnamese and naming the item, a missing ffmpeg, ffprobe, face, font manifest or toolchain executable, a digest mismatch, and each refusal of PilotSettings.Validate (D-004).
- Security considerations (S09):
  - Listener on 127.0.0.1 only, checked at start-up; any other bound address stops the app (C-011, D-003, R-007).
  - Request guard on the seventeen state-changing routes listed in section 6 (C-014, C-030, R-006).
  - Content policy allowing only the app's own origin and in-page media, no framing, no referrer, microphone only for the app's own origin (C-011).
  - Uploaded names are matched against names the fact sheet declares and then resolved with the toolchain's plain-name rule; an uploaded name is never used as a path (C-024, R-009).
  - Approval stays bound to the recomputed hash by the toolchain (F-014); the app sends the manifest value it shows; an employee approval names the employee (C-021, R-011).
  - The per-start token is held in memory only, never logged or stored (D-014).
  - Compliance: no generative, speech or metered component is referenced or started (C-016); nothing publishes (C-019).
- Performance considerations (S08): the live check is bounded by C-027 and answered in process (A-010, R-013); produce time is bounded by the toolchain's process bounds (F-011) and the app's own bound (D-009); uploads have per-route size ceilings no lower than the toolchain's own upload ceiling.
- Deployment or operability impact: the app runs from the repository build on the operator's computer (A-004), starts from the desktop shortcut (D-013, A-009), and needs no container, database or service (C-018). The S06 database area changes nothing (D-008).
